# Wasif Rehman - Full Stack Developer

> Wasif Rehman is a Full Stack Developer specializing in React, Next.js, Node.js, React Native, Python, and AI/ML integration. This portfolio showcases professional projects, technical blogs, and development expertise.

Available for freelance and full-time roles. Experienced in building enterprise systems, AI-powered mobile apps, e-commerce platforms, and real-time web applications. Skilled in TypeScript, Python, JavaScript, Firebase, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and cloud infrastructure.

## Projects

- [ERPNext System](https://wasifrehman.com/projects/erpnext-system): Enterprise-grade ERP system with 35+ modules including accounting, inventory, HR/payroll, CRM. Built with Python, Vue.js, MariaDB, Redis, and Frappe Framework
- [FreeNote](https://wasifrehman.com/projects/freenote-app): AI-powered voice note-taking app with real-time transcription, smart summarization, interactive AI chat, PDF export. Built with React Native, Expo, Firebase, and Groq AI
- [Prove It Auto](https://wasifrehman.com/projects/prove-it-auto): AI-powered car maintenance app with dashboard light scanning, tire inspection using Google Gemini AI. Built with React Native, Node.js, MongoDB
- [E-Commerce Platform](https://wasifrehman.com/projects/ecommerce-platform): Complete e-commerce solution with Stripe payments, admin dashboard. Built with MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js
- [Live Voting System](https://wasifrehman.com/projects/live-voting-system): Real-time live voting system with accurate vote forecasting. Built with React, Node.js, MongoDB, Socket.io
- [Academic Analytics](https://wasifrehman.com/projects/academic-analytics): Comprehensive academic analytics system with team collaboration and drag-and-drop interface. MERN stack
- [Bible Trader](https://wasifrehman.com/projects/bible-trader): Marketplace platform with escrow payments, Stripe integration, and trade system. Built with React, TypeScript, Supabase
- [Master Man Power Bureau](https://wasifrehman.com/projects/mmpb-recruitment): International recruitment platform with job listings, CV management, AWS S3. Built with Next.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Prisma
- [Zareen Couture](https://wasifrehman.com/projects/zareen-couture): Luxury Pakistani bridal couture e-commerce with custom order system and virtual consultation. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
